propositions: Hand-authoring mapping config vocabulary and axis maps is error-prone; a read-only command should probe a live Jira project and emit a suggested [tool.rebar.mapping] block with discovered vocabulary and identity-seed maps.

The new verb must be named 'rebar bridge suggest-mapping' to avoid collision with the retired 'bridge-probe' alias, and must be wired as a parser, dispatcher, and handler within the bridge command group.

Vocabulary discovery uses only high-level pycontribs jira.JIRA public methods (issue_types, priorities, issue_link_types, statuses, createmeta_issuetypes, search_issues, transitions); no private REST or direct HTTP access.

Default invocation emits the mapping block to stdout as TOML without writing any file; --write mode deep-merges under [mapping.projects.<KEY>] in rebar.toml, preserving existing hand-edited values and flat [jira]/[tracker] sections via a new orchestrator (_emit_config_toml).

The probe discovers statuses (global set, not per-project), issue types and hierarchy (dropped if hierarchyLevel absent), priorities, link types, transition hints (partial/best-effort, flagged as advisory), and stubs for createmeta required fields not in the outbound baseline.

Tests use a fake probe port for offline validation (no live Jira or CI credentials), and verify read-only behavior, file preservation on --write, partial transition discovery, and vocabulary population.
